Name: Anthro Quinn
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
This is a portraits and sprites mod for Quinn so that she fits in with the characters from Anthro Characters Continued.

Earlier this year, I created portraits and sprites for the anthro versions of the genderswaps of Alex, Sebastian, and Shane before their ACC artwork came out. Now that its come out, I edited together Shaun/Shauna's, Abigail's, and Quinn's sprites and portraits together so that both versions of Shauna's artwork can be used together. She's a crocodile probably, but you can interpret her as any sort of horned reptile, as long as you can imagine it.


[color=#D4D4D8]This is a standard Content Patcher mod. Install it like you would any other.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
 This mod only features Quinn's Normal, Winter, Beach, and Job outfits. This means Quinn has fewer outfits than before. However, this should still be enough to make Quinn feel complete.

[/color]Hopefully, this will be the first in a series of projects meant to utilize anthro artworks that would otherwise not be simultaneously used with each other, or otherwise unused.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I would highly suggest using this mod alongside Anthro Characters Continued. Of course, I also made this with my own Alternate Anthro Shauna in mind.[/color]
